title: Kesari Select · Travel Operations Platform
tagline: High-volume travel operations, ERP integrations & production delivery
description: I work on the Laravel application behind Kesari Select's sales and operations workflows. The platform handles an estimated 10K+ inquiries per day and is used by roughly 700–1,000 internal team members. My work spans finance data exchange, booking flows, alerts and deployment.
role: I built scheduled DBF export/reconciliation workflows, Cash Contra requisitions, ERP API handling and reminders; expanded multi-role financial approvals; and handled application deployment and production issues. Kesari Select is a team-built product.

flow.label: AWS S3
flow.detail: Stage, publish and archive DBF exports

flow.label: Operations
flow.detail: Scheduled jobs, approvals and audit logs

highlights: Built repeatable ERP exports with S3 staging, archives, export logs and lookback for missed records.
Connected Sales, Operations and Finance through approval gates, RFQ and stock alerts.
Handled app deployments with Docker, Nginx/PHP-FPM, EC2, SSL and post-release checks.
Improved one observed page load from ~15s to ~3s by optimizing the backend.
metricNote: Approximate platform scale and observed performance figures are developer-reported estimates, not audited analytics.

title: Excel-to-Email Campaign Engine
tagline: Upload contacts. Queue delivery. Monitor engagement.
description: Built the initial version of an internal email campaign system. Staff upload an Excel list, write and test an email, then Laravel queue jobs send to recipients without holding a browser request open.
role: Created the original schema, validation, queued sender, pause/resume controls, tracking pixel, hourly open-log processor, exports and sender settings. Later work was collaborative.
highlights: Separated Excel upload and email composition from background sending.
Allowed test sends, pause and resume without restarting a campaign.
Moved email-open persistence to hourly batches instead of writing on every pixel request.

title: Smart Print · Operations & Access Control
tagline: Inquiry capture, role permissions and print-job reliability
description: Worked in an existing Laravel print-management system to improve prospect intake, role permissions, task safety and configurable print-job sheets.
role: Built the prospect module across schema, Eloquent, controllers and AJAX; made role updates safer with scoped joins/upsert-style writes; added soft-delete behavior and fixed print/prepress options. Task/job modules predated my contributions.
highlights: Prospect inquiries with validation, soft delete and permissions.
Role-specific edit/delete controls and safer permission updates.
Consistent extra/VAT persistence and configurable design/prepress options.
